criteria: An integrated offline test exercises existing chat -> Add agent -> inspect/edit/refreeze brief -> join with zero inference -> explicit reviewer prompt -> attributed answer through actual UI/router/ordinary owners and a recording transport.

Membership changes during joining have an explicit re-review/reconciliation path that links the same allocated session; repeated Check again must not retry a stale revision forever or allocate a replacement.
Lost review/confirmation responses survive dialog close, route unmount, reload and server restart through original request/join/allocation identities; recovery cannot silently start a second join.

Add agent matches the approved reference: restore Cancel and fresh-session footer copy, runtime ordering and the real repository display; preserve Before joining, editable brief, Back/drafts and existing shared controls. Any intentional design change needs explicit approval.

Pin the existing Symposium approval, reference hashes, owned files and behavior checks in the approved-design ledger; independently compare final combined desktop/mobile, light/dark and narrow-screen renders, keyboard/focus and refusal/recovery states.

Reads future discussion retains authorized prompts AND replies for delivery before the reader's next requested turn, with durable identities/cursors. Reading alone invokes no inference or automatic response loop; immediate silent native delivery is not an extra prerequisite without a demonstrated product need.

Defaults and explicit @ selection use stable recipients and ordinary queue/Stop owners. Same-account agents keep independent sessions; partial recipient failures and retries preserve successful outcomes. Reviewer can read Architect's answer and respond when explicitly addressed.

Reuse the active native capture/count/consume work, with exact reviewed context, per-sampling request permits, tool-loop settings, acknowledgement and reply identity preserved. Stop after dispatch begins remains best effort with uncertain outcomes protected against replay.

Refresh the current Telos checkpoint, attach exact source/test/render evidence and satisfy normal CI/review gates. Milestone completion establishes bounded source/offline acceptance only; full account/runtime parity, physical iOS qualification and production activation remain separate.

Contract acceptance: exercise the actual shared client/server protocol and error projection for request/join identity, revisions, definite rejection versus uncertain outcomes, recovery and reply attribution. Through native owners, prove count and dispatch use the same retained request, with one-use admission per sampling request and invalidation/refreeze after relevant source/settings changes.

Persistence acceptance: use actual owner schema initialization and migrations with synthetic data, including an older supported schema. Test transaction rollback, concurrent confirmation, lost responses, route remount/reload, restart, and crash after allocation before recording. All ambiguous recovery keeps the original allocation; membership conflict permits explicit re-review and reconciliation without a replacement session.

Application integration acceptance: exercise the production composition path with its real authentication/session, router, preparation, persistence, dispatch and reply owners. Substitute only external execution/account services at their boundary with deterministic recording transports. A test must fail if required owners are omitted from application wiring; a separately hand-wired router or canned browser response is not sufficient evidence.

Multi-agent acceptance: exercise Defaults and explicit @ selection, independent sessions on the same account, independent partial failures/retries, exact reply attribution, authorized prompt-and-reply reader delivery before the next requested turn, no inference from joining/reading alone, and Stop/uncertain outcomes without replay.

UX acceptance: compare actual approved Add agent and Before joining screens, shared chat and recipient controls against pinned references in desktop/mobile, narrow layouts, light/dark and keyboard flows. Verify retained edits, focus restoration, refusal, stale review and uncertain recovery. Simulated browser fixtures establish UI behavior only and must be labeled separately from integrated backend evidence.

Cross-feature acceptance: on combined accepted Telos and Symposium code, run a bounded offline regression suite through shared ordinary-session, context, tool and dispatch owners. Preserve separate Telos role/control authority and Symposium participation, correct attribution and no cross-session context or command leakage. This does not authorize a new combined orchestration feature.

Evidence and qualification: maintain one requirements-to-evidence map with contract owner, exact accepted source/PR, test command/result, visual comparison and open gaps. Contribute evidence as each slice lands; record source merged, integrated behavior verified and approved UX verified separately. Offline/CI acceptance does not establish live OpenShell/runtime qualification. Coordinate later live checks sequentially on one separately authorized feasible target; do not create per-feature staging instances or reactivate retired staging.
